name: VieMed Healthcare
old_description: Founded in 2006 by Casey Hoyt and Michael Moore, VieMed was built on friendship, loyalty, and treating others right. These ideals remain at the core of our culture as we continue to grow, expand into new markets, and advance care for patients throughout the United States.
about:
VieMed Healthcare is based in Lafayette, Louisiana, and was founded in 2006 by Casey Hoyt and Michael Moore. The company began with a focus on friendship, loyalty, and treating others right, principles that continue to shape its culture as it expands across the United States.

The organization provides a range of in-home clinical services, including respiratory therapy, disease management for conditions such as COPD, neuromuscular diseases, and obstructive sleep apnea, connected health remote monitoring, in-home sleep testing, behavioral health counseling, and a specialized PACE program aimed at reducing hospital readmissions. It also operates VieMed Healthcare Staffing (VHS), a Joint Commission‑certified division that places clinical professionals in healthcare facilities nationwide. As a publicly traded company on the Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX) and NASDAQ (VMD), VieMed serves thousands of patients across the country through a high‑tech, high‑touch care model.

VieMed’s primary customers are patients with chronic respiratory and sleep disorders, as well as healthcare organizations — hospitals, health systems, and payers — that require staffing solutions or disease‑management partnerships. The company works directly with physicians and insurers to deliver care in the home setting.

The company states its mission is to expand access to high‑quality, innovative healthcare solutions across the U.S., guided by core values of respect, integrity, perseverance, excellence, and competitiveness. Its vision is to become the nation’s most trusted, comprehensive partner in care, uniting healthcare services, workforce solutions, and consumer health innovations.

about:
VirTechnology Contract Manufacturing operates from Windsor, Vermont, as a start-up technology company specializing in contract manufacturing solutions. The firm was founded to deliver high-quality, customized manufacturing services with a focus on innovation and precision.

The shop provides turnkey PCB assembly covering surface-mount placement, through-hole soldering, depaneling, functional testing, visual inspection, and box-build integration. It runs SMT pick-and-place machines and a multi-zone reflow oven, handling component sizes from 0402 up to 40 mm × 40 mm. Additional services include component procurement, fixture creation, and kitting. CNC machining for low-complexity parts, injection molding, and conformal coating are listed as coming soon. The company targets prototype through mid-scale production volumes.

VirTechnology serves customers in medical, military, weapons, and aerospace assemblies, keeping intellectual property and supply chains within the United States. It also works with a broader range of industries seeking contract manufacturing partners.

name: Virginia Food Works
old_description: The cannery is open to commercial clients by appointment only. Scheduling is prioritized on a first come, first served basis and reservations should be made up to a month in advance during the busy season (June-December). For “home canning” availability, visit the
about:
Virginia Food Works operates a VDACS-inspected commercial kitchen at the Prince Edward County Cannery in Farmville, Virginia. The nonprofit organization was established to support Virginia farmers by providing a rental production facility for small-batch commercial retail co-packing during harvest season.

The facility offers appointment-based access to licensed equipment including kettles, mixers, fillers, and canners, with trained staff assisting clients through hot-fill, water-bath, and pressure canning processes. Production runs are scheduled Thursday through Saturday on a first-come, first-served basis, with peak demand from June through December. The kitchen specializes in acid and acidified foods—such as sauces, jams, relishes, and syrups—made from locally grown produce like tomatoes, berries, apples, peppers, and ginger root. Because of its regulatory scope, the facility cannot handle products containing meat, fish, or dairy.

Virginia Food Works serves both Virginia and out-of-state farmers looking to preserve seasonal harvests and reduce waste, as well as emerging small-business food entrepreneurs navigating commercial production for the first time. Clients range from growers creating value-added products for retail markets to startups needing guidance on recipe scaling, regulatory compliance, and process authority reviews. The organization also assists with VDACS registration and food safety training requirements.

The nonprofit's resource-first approach aims to strengthen Virginia's food system by helping producers transform perishable crops into shelf-stable goods that can be sold year-round, expanding market opportunities for local agriculture while keeping more food production within the state.

old_description: Virginia Packing is a specialty co-packer for cured meats, cheeses and other quality foods. We specialize in products that require careful handling and extra attention to detail.
about:
Virginia Packing operates from Toano, Virginia, where it was founded in 2011. The company functions as a specialty co-packer focused on cured meats, cheeses, and other quality foods that demand careful handling.

The facility provides USDA- and FDA-inspected processing services including high-speed precision slicing, deboning, modified atmosphere packaging (MAP), and vacuum shrink packaging. Equipment includes a Weber high-speed slicer and a GEA thermoforming packaging machine. The site also offers air-conditioned, refrigerated, and frozen storage along with cross-docking logistics, leveraging proximity to the Hampton Roads ports and Interstate 95.

Virginia Packing serves the specialty food sector, with a noted client relationship as the exclusive meat slicer and packer of Spanish jamón for La Tienda, a online retailer of Spanish imports. Its customer base includes brands requiring co-packing for cured meats, sausages, cheeses, and similar products.

The company positions itself as large enough to maintain equipment and facilities while remaining small enough to give each product special attention, emphasizing careful handling and exact specifications.

name: Virginia Vinegar Works
old_description: This rare vinegar is dark red and heavy bodied with a rich nose. It goes well with bold, mixed greens and blue cheese. Particularly good in a meat marinade or to add structure in marinara sauces and stews
about:
Virginia Vinegar Works is based in Shipman, Virginia, and has been producing artisanal vinegars since 2008. The operation began with wine vinegar made in porcelain crocks and has since expanded to stainless steel tanks and oak barrels for aging.

The company crafts wine vinegars, seasonal fruit vinegars, and malt vinegars using the traditional Orleans method, a slow conversion process that preserves the character of the base wine. Production involves stainless steel tanks for fermentation and older wine barrels for aging, after which barrels are selected for blends or single-varietal bottlings. Fruit vinegars combine rich wine vinegar with fresh fruit from nearby farms, while malt vinegars are made from local craft beer, yielding a robust, umami-rich product. The lineup includes varietal-specific vinegars such as Cabernet Franc, Chardonnay, Petit Verdot, and Albariño, as well as blended heritage red and white wine vinegars, white balsamic, sherry vinegar, and malt vinegar.

Virginia Vinegar Works serves professional chefs, restaurants, gourmet food outlets, and home cooks seeking exceptional flavor. Its products are marketed for both culinary and gift use, with direct shipping to customers. The company also offers consultation services.

The business was born from a desire to add exceptional flavor to the great local produce and meats available in central Virginia. The founders emphasize that the slow Orleans method and barrel aging retain the original character of the wine, creating vinegars with richness and depth that rapid commercial processes cannot achieve.

name: VoltServer®
old_description: Another step in empowering more industries with intelligent power distribution East Greenwich, April 12, 2024 – VoltServer, a leading provider of Digital Electricity™ (DE), Fault Managed Power solutions, has attained Cisco Select Developer status. This accomplishment demonstrates VoltServer’s expertise and solidifies its position as a trusted and valued collaborator within the industry. The collaboration between VoltServer and Cisco opens new opportunities for both companies to drive innovation in efficient and sustainable power delivery solutions. With VoltServer’s proven expertise in Digital Electricity™ combined with Cisco’s leadership in the Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) technologies, the companies are driving advancements in powering industrial and outdoor environments where traditional power sources are limited or inaccessible. VoltServer’s Digital Edge Solutions, combined with Cisco’s IIOT platforms, enable enterprise-grade connectivity in even the most rugged and challenging spaces. Together, they empower organizations to deploy Cisco IE Series Power over Ethernet (PoE) switches deeper into their networks, delivering enhanced efficiency, connectivity, and performance. “We are very excited to become a trusted powering solution for Cisco’s IIoT solutions,” states Matt Giuliano, EVP and GM, Emeritus, Communications and In-Building at VoltServer, “and to continue to work with Cisco’s engineering teams to collectively address joint go-to-market opportunities in several strategic vertical markets including extended campus & outdoor spaces, ports and airports, utilities and oil & gas.” The attainment of Cisco Select Developer status marks a significant milestone for VoltServer as they continue their 10-year deployment history as the industry’s pioneering leader in Fault Managed Power, via their Digital Electricity platform. “We are driven by innovation and are proud to be setting the standard in Fault Managed Power Systems. Together, with our valued partners, we are solving the world’s power distribution demands and building solutions to create a better future for us all,” says Stephen Eaves, CEO and Founder at VoltServer.
about:
VoltServer is headquartered in East Greenwich, Rhode Island. The company was founded by Stephen Eaves, who serves as CEO, and has a 10-year deployment history as of 2024. Matt Giuliano holds the role of EVP and GM, Emeritus, Communications and In-Building.

VoltServer develops and manufactures Digital Electricity™ (DE), a patented fault-managed power system classified as Class 4 under the 2023 National Electrical Code. The technology splits energy into packets transferred from a Transmitter unit to a Receiver unit, with safety monitoring after each packet. The company reports more than 1,000 building installations and 40,000 circuits across large venues.

The company serves telecommunications service providers deploying 5G and Wi-Fi networks, transportation hubs such as ports and airports, enterprise buildings and campuses, industrial manufacturing facilities, data centers, and building electrification projects. VoltServer also collaborates with partners including Cisco, where it holds Select Developer status for IIoT power solutions, and Eaton for critical infrastructure.

VoltServer states its technology reduces installation time by using existing data pathways and hybrid fiber cable, lowers material costs by eliminating conduit, and improves safety by halting hazardous current within milliseconds. The platform is designed for energy efficiency and can qualify for LEED credits. The company says it is driven by innovation and aims to set the standard in fault-managed power systems.
